headerDisplay:
Tovala Smart Oven Integration


Setup Instructions:

1 - Enter your Tovala email and password below.
2 - After saving and restarting Homebridge, your custom recipes will be available as switches.

For detailed setup instructions, please visit our GitHub page.
footerDisplay: Tovala Oven Plugin: Control your smart oven from Homebridge

name.title: Name
name.description: Plugin name as displayed in the Homebridge log

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: Leave this blank on setup, it will be filled for you

groupAccessories.title: Group recipe switches under one accessory
groupAccessories.description: When enabled (recommended) Homebridge exposes ONE accessory that expands to show every recipe switch.

enableDoneSensor.title: Enable "Oven Done" motion sensor
enableDoneSensor.description: Creates a motion-sensor accessory that fires when the cook finishes.

doneSensorPoll.title: Status-poll interval (seconds)
doneSensorPoll.description: How often to poll /cook/status while the oven is running. Minimum 5 s.
